summary.text: Christopher Campbell, a Kentucky Party candidate and health care worker from Marion County who served in the National Guard, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. Senate seat in Kentucky to Andy Barr.
He said he supported a Medicare for All-style system and reducing U.S. military spending abroad.

paragraphs.text: Campbell says he has lived in Kentucky his whole life and grew up in Marion County.
He says he is a graduate of Kentucky's public school system and Eastern Kentucky University; a campaign press release says he earned a master of public health degree there in 2019.
Ballotpedia says he served in the U.S. Army National Guard from 2013 to 2019, and the press release describes him as a former member of the Kentucky National Guard.

Campbell says he has worked in health care, including in nursing homes, hospitals, health departments and rape crisis centers; Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work as an independent contractor.
The press release identifies him as a member of the Kentucky Party Executive Committee.
He received 2.1% of the vote to Andy Barr's 55.0%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
